# Fedora packages required on the host for deps/sysroot to load.
# Derived from ldd of every .so under sysroot/usr/GNUstep (+ /usr/local),
# mapped through rpm -qf inside the build container.
#
#   sudo dnf install $(grep -v '^#' host-packages.txt)
#
# Notes:
#  * libdispatch (swift-corelibs-libdispatch) is both a build and a
#    runtime dependency of libgnustep-base, which links it directly.
#  * libcxx/libcxxabi are here because libobjc was built with libc++,
#    matching the -stdlib=libc++ the macholo executable uses.
#  * libstdc++ comes in via libicu, not via anything GNUstep built.
#
# Compile-time only, so NOT listed below:
#   clang lld cmake libcxx-devel libcxxabi-devel

cyrus-sasl-lib
glibc
gmp
gnutls
keyutils-libs
krb5-libs
libbrotli
libcbor
libcom_err
libcurl
libcxx
libcxxabi
libdispatch
libevent
libffi
libfido2
libgcc
libicu
libidn2
libnghttp2
libnghttp3
libpsl
libselinux
libssh
libstdc++
libtasn1
libunistring
libxcrypt
libxml2
libxslt
nettle
ngtcp2
ngtcp2-crypto-ossl
openldap
openssl-libs
p11-kit
pcre2
systemd-libs
xz-libs
